verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents asynchronous transcription of recorded audio (docs-1), and its SDK "uploads, submits, and polls for you" (docs-18). Docs-3 also implies the standard path uses polling or webhooks, and a community member saw a polling loop in an example (comm-3), so a create-then-poll job workflow clearly exists. However, the evidence never names the job states or the raw status-polling endpoint and its semantics, and the SDK hides the polling. missing for 10: documented job-state lifecycle (e.g. queued/processing/completed/error), explicit REST status-polling endpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the polling flow.
